subject: Novacore — cluster sizing & ramping scenarios (proposal)
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex@novacore.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Novacore — cluster sizing & ramping scenarios (proposal)

Alex — great to meet last week. As promised, attached is a short proposal outlining three practical dedicated reservation paths tailored to your inference mix and launch timeline. High level below, PDF + cost model attached.

Summary (quick):
- Option A — Baseline Starter: 8 A100-equivalent GPUs reserved, warm-start activation in week 1, 4-week ramp to 50% of target throughput. Good for a measured pilot and predictable monthly spend.
- Option B — Production Balanced: 32 A100-equivalent GPUs reserved (min guarantee 24), phased activation over 6 weeks with a 2-week pre-warm and 10% burst window from shared pool. Best balance of cost and performance for steady traffic.
- Option C — Growth Sprint: 96 A100-equivalent GPUs reserved (min guarantee 64), immediate lane allocation with staged burst & hot-standby for latency-critical workloads. Includes elevated SLA and dedicated warmup credits.

Key variables we modeled: GPU class (A100 vs H100), kv-cache hit assumptions, average sequence length, and expected concurrency per endpoint. The attached spreadsheet has the per-token cost curves and projected burn at 60/75/90% utilization.

Ramp mechanics & milestones (example for Option B):
- Week 0: Contract signed, final model build pinned to v1.2.
- Week 1: Provisioning & baseline tests (warm-start credits applied).
- Week 2-3: Canary traffic (20-40%), application-level smoke tests.
- Week 4: 70% activation, metrics review and throughput tuning.
- Week 6: Full production activation; automatic fallback policy engaged.

Questions for you so we can finalize the quote:
1) Preferred GPU family (H100 or A100 equivalence)?
2) Any hard min-GPU requirement from your SRE side?
3) Procurement timeline & PO cadence (target sign date)?

I pulled a quick draft DocuSign link in the Drive folder; once we align on option and GPU type I’ll push the revised figures and a procurement-friendly summary page.

Thanks — I’ll follow up in a couple days if I don’t hear back.

—
Irene Choi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
irene@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
Redwood Inference

Irene — thanks for this, appreciate the clear options. A few follow-ups: 

- We're leaning toward the Balanced path but would prefer an H100 baseline if the pricing delta is reasonable. Do you have a quick delta estimate (A100 -> H100) baked into the spreadsheet?
- Our SRE wants a minimum of 16 GPUs guaranteed for the first 30 days (to support CI and nightly runs); can you accommodate that as a temporary floor?
- Procurement: target approval is internal by Oct 1. We may need a short 30-day payment term to align with our quarter-end.

Also looping in procurement@novacore.ai in case they want to review the DocuSign earlier. Will your team handle the SOC2 evidence pages if we request them as part of the security review?

Cheers,
Alex
CTO — Novacore AI

Alex / Procurement team — thanks for the quick turnaround. Per our internal review we've prepared an updated offer reflecting your asks. Highlights below; updated PDF attached in Drive and DocuSign link is live.

Updated Offer (summary):
- Selected path: Production Balanced (Option B) with H100-equivalent pricing.
- Min guarantee: 16 GPUs guaranteed for first 30 days (as requested). After day 30, automatic stepdown to a 24-month schedule: 24 GPU min for months 2-3 (phased) and 16 GPU min thereafter unless you trigger expansion. We included an optional 90-day stepdown to 8 GPUs if usage remains <20% for two consecutive 30-day windows.
- Activation cadence: provisioning (day 0-3), pre-warm (day 4-10), canary (day 11-24), full ramp by day 42.
- Payment terms: Net-30 available pending final signature and a one-time admin PO. Markus has prepared the short payment addendum (attached to DocuSign).
- Compliance: SOC2 one-pager & dedicated VPC checklist are linked in the Drive folder; Marissa will coordinate any additional evidence requests.

Action items:
- Alex / Procurement: please review DocuSign and sign the acceptance page by Sep 25 to keep the above activation targets.
- Marissa: please confirm H100-numbers and upload the updated cost sheet to Drive.
- Markus: please confirm the Net-30 addendum language is good to go and confirm any escalations required.

If you want a quick 30-minute call early next week to walk through the ramp schedule and the billing cadence I’m happy to set that up.

Best,
Irene Choi
